summary: Re-ran ORI-RN-004 at main 45464ed0. Found the committed driver never drove AC-3 case 2 (endpoint loss + Retry) despite the boundary contract requiring it, and implemented that leg on all three platforms in tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-example-proof.test.ts: a BackendSession wrapper that tracks the owned backend across restart() cycles (records survive for the manifest/correlation), an iOS retry phase via one-off Maestro composer flows, an Android turn-5 phase after the stop hot path (no device reads inserted into it), and web retry flags in the pass predicate; screenshots are now captured even when a leg's retry phase fails so evidence always binds to the current run. Ran the full real proof repeatedly (R2 baseline without the leg: 3/3 platforms, 19 provider records; R2B/R2D/R2E with it). AC-1, AC-2, AC-4, AC-3 case 1 and AC-5 are green with fresh evidence; the web leg passes the full retry recovery (new completed record, exactly 1 retained user turn); iOS/Android surface the sanitized error + accessible Retry (visible in the committed screenshots) but retry completion dies server-side (error record, 0 deltas, ~330-560ms). Root-caused headlessly with the hook's exact SDK classes (Chat from @ai-sdk/react 4.0.92 + DefaultChatTransport from ai 7.0.89, throttle 50) and bisected on the real backend: the regenerate payload contains duplicated assistant entries carrying repeated OpenAI itemIds, which the provider rejects; any variant leaving each itemId unique completes. Evidence directory fully refreshed (run-manifest, provider-correlation, metro.log, ios/android light+dark screenshots, AC-5 compiler artifacts) and README.md authored with the corrected web-leg note (the driver submits the seed prompt, assistantResponded true — the old false negative is superseded). All gates green: root typecheck, biome ci ., check:fallow, scoped tsc via the AC-5 case (exit 0, negative control holds, whole-example exit 2 retained separately).
assumptions: The instruction to update "ORI-RN-004's own evidence README" was realized as authoring tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-RN-004/README.md — no README existed in that allowlisted directory, and the stale assistantResponded-false note it superseded lived in run artifacts and the FIX-ORI-RN-004-1 evidence dir (outside this task's writeAllowlist).

RED for this re-run cycle was recorded as two real facets rather than a fabricated failing command: (1) the committed evidence bound candidate cffcdb95 and claimed completed:false (the task's evidence gate failed against the current tree), and (2) the committed driver contained no endpoint-loss/retry assertion group at all. The retry-completion failure was then observed live on the real stack in runs R2B/R2C/R2D/R2E; the original implementation RED (route absent from the compiler program, Android enabled=false composer, web not-configured bundle) was already recorded by cycle 0 / FIX-ORI-RN-004-1 and remains on main.

The diagnostic probe scripts under .tmp/ORI-RN-004/cycle-1 import the SDK by absolute worktree path because 'ai' resolves only from apps/example's node_modules and apps/example is writeProhibited; they are diagnostic artifacts, not product code.
blockers: AC-3 case 2's retry-completion oracle fails on iOS and Android because of a defect outside this task's writeAllowlist: after endpoint loss, the Retry control (chat.retry = clearError + regenerate) sends a request whose payload, assembled by apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts driving @ai-sdk/react@4.0.92 + ai@7.0.89, contains duplicated assistant message entries with repeated OpenAI itemIds in providerMetadata; the provider rejects it and the server emits an error record with 0 deltas. The fix requires either editing apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts (state sanitization before transport, or a dependency upgrade — dependency installation is ORI-AI-001's ownership) or sanitizing the payload in apps/example/server/** (also writeProhibited). No allowlisted file can fix it: the screen has no message-mutation API, and re-sending via sendMessage would duplicate the retained user turn, violating the exactly-1 oracle. Web passes the full recovery; only native is red.

scope_impact.found: AC-3 case 2 requires 'Retry creates a new real request ID, completes a provider-correlated answer' on 3/3 platforms, but no file in this task's writeAllowlist can influence the regenerate request payload — the oracle is unsatisfiable here while the hook/SDK emits duplicate-itemId messages.
scope_impact.change: Make the payload fix a prerequisite: either ORI-AI-001 (or a new FIX task scoped to apps/example/lib/use-live-chat.ts, an @ai-sdk/react/ai upgrade, or server-side payload sanitization) lands first and this task re-runs the committed driver for a green R-final, or move the retry-completion oracle to the hook owner and leave this task's AC-3 responsible for the active-Stop abort plus the sanitized-error/Retry surface (both of which it now proves on all 3 platforms).
